questions.q: All the following are classified as **non-tax revenues** of the government EXCEPT
options: Petroleum Profits Tax and Personal Income Tax
Mining royalties, license fees, and highway tolls
Dividends and operating surpluses from state-owned enterprises
questions.explain:
**Non-tax revenues** are earnings generated by the government through non-taxation sources such as administrative fees, fines, mineral royalties, and dividends from state corporations. 

**Petroleum Profits Tax** and **Personal Income Tax** are direct forms of statutory **tax revenue**.
